claude_cases.name: candidate-guard
criteria: no scope expansion or external action

claude_runtime: same restricted read-only tools and default model as run 7; each arm extracted to frozen external directory
codex_runtime: native config, ephemeral read-only sandbox, approvals never, native installed candidate
stopping_rule: One attempt per case. No retry on case failure. Stop remaining inference on account authentication/quota block. No instruction edits while samples run. Record every failure.
baseline: Five frozen 0.1.1 samples and five first-candidate samples retained in run 8
candidate: 0.1.2 second candidate: five sentences with per-sentence budget; elapsed time versus effort
limits: five samples per arm on one synthetic scenario; no no-skill control or blind scorer
CLI observations do not establish desktop picker refresh, other surfaces, marketplace acceptance or product value
